description: This file defines a React component called GlobalSidebarLayout for a Next.js application. It renders a fixed sidebar with navigation links, branding, and expand/collapse functionality, intended for consistent layout across pages. It manages sidebar state with localStorage, and dynamically highlights active links based on current path.

methods.name: GlobalSidebarLayout
methods.description: Main React component that renders the sidebar and content, managing its expand/collapse state and navigation links.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Determines whether a navigation link is active based on current path.
